DistractedPenalty.Description: A factor by which view range and hearing range will be divided when this NPC is distracted

AlertedRange.Description: A range within which the player can be seen/sensed when the NPC is alerted to their presence

EatItem.Description: The item this NPC will find when it rummages for food

SleepingAttack.Description: Attack to use on NPCs that annoy it while sleeping

FoodNPCGroups.Description: The groups of edible NPCs that will come from triggering the beacon

FoodNPCBeacon.Description: The spawn beacon to trigger to create an edible NPC

FoodNPCItem.Description: The edible NPC in item form

WarnGroups.Description: The groups to warn when spotting an enemy

AttackSequence.Description: The attack sequence to use in combat

AttackDistance.Description: The distance at which an NPC will execute attacks

CombatRelativeTurnSpeed.Description: Modifier that decides turn speed difference in combat

ScrapperNPCGroups.Description: The groups of NPCs that will come from triggering the beacon to be thrown at the player during combat

ScrapperNPCBeacon.Description: The spawn beacon to trigger to create a throwable NPC

ScrapperRole.Description: The type of NPC to throw at the player when successfully catching it

HealEntityEffect.Description: The entity effect to apply to handle healing this NPC

HealEatDuration.Description: How long the NPC should eat for before the healing is triggered

IsMemory.Description: Defines if the NPC is a memory

MemoriesCategory.Description: Defines the category of the memory

MemoriesNameOverride.Description: Overrides the memory name if set

NameTranslationKey.Description: Translation key for NPC name display
